verdict.notes: Word opened and rendered the document. The layout is clean on one page: tables intact, no wrapped money values, footer mark preserved. Every rubric check passes except the Notes replacement, where the old Notes body line was kept and the new text sits in a shrunken spacer paragraph. OfficeCLI also wrote docProps/custom.xml (OfficeCLI.Version), which is harmless.
verdict.weakAgentStruggle: Moderate slog on table structure. add --type row --after produced a malformed 5-cell row with no gridSpan or borders on a merged-grid table and gave no warning, so the agent cloned with --from and then used move. Setting the width of a gridSpan cell split the width evenly and desynced tblGrid, which forced a raw-set setattr on each gridCol through an undocumented 'attr=value' form. Swapping the SVG gave a blank PNG fallback with no set-level fallback= option. The agent also flagged the Notes/anchor question as a judgment call and chose wrongly.
